THE LOCAL MEANING

What it is.

A bonefish trip on the flats of Andros in The Bahamas. The common format combines a lodge stay with daily skiff trips, with wading where the local plan permits it. The water and access choice matter more than the generic phrase “tropical flats.”

The Bahamas Ministry of Tourism Launches 2nd Annual Bonefishing Tournament Series ↗Andros Island Bonefish Club, Andros Bahamas ↗The Best Bonefishing in the Bahamas - Fly Fisherman ↗

How it is fished.

Sight cast flies from a skiff or on foot.

The research describes sight casts with flies from a skiff or on foot. Ask how the guide selects between these options for the tide, wind, and your mobility. October to mid-July is one travel operator’s window. It does not define a national season or establish every Andros lodge’s dates.

Planning format: Multi-day; flats lodge and daily skiff. Confirm the actual duration with the provider.

EDITORIAL PREPARATION ADVICE

What to bring.

  • Polarized glasses, sun coverage, and a secure hat.
  • Wading footwear only after the lodge confirms the bottom and intended route.
  • Fly tackle matched to the lodge’s recommended setup and baggage allowance.

Before you go.

Does every Andros bonefish day include wading?

No. The documented methods include both skiff and foot access. Agree on the actual route with the guide before you pack wading equipment.

What seasonal window does the evidence support?

October to mid-July is one established travel operator's trip window. A seasonal account does not confirm current availability. Use the linked authority for current rules.

What must I confirm before I book this trip?

Confirm skiff time, guide service, flies, and any rental tackle. Ask which meals, transfers, and fishing permits the package includes. Discuss skiff access, wading needs, and weather alternatives before arrival. Castward has no confirmed guide inventory for this trip type.
